description.text: Dragon Discovery, mostly of Dragon-type Pokémon. Each Happy Meal held a four-card pack with one holo card, a poster and a sheet of stickers. It began in France on 4 December 2024 and reached the United States on 21 January 2025, where ordering it through the McDonald's app also unlocked rewards in Pokémon TCG Pocket.
